inputs: frozen journey contract and exact candidate
outputs: screenshots, console/request evidence and identity manifest
budget: local deterministic browser tests; no paid calls
triggering_workflows: UI journey acceptance or Hamilton flow change

approval_requirements: No production mutation or provider activation is authorized by running a journey.
abstain_when: required browser or frozen source is unavailable
